questions.question: How satisfied were you with the academic programme at your host institution? *
Additional comments:
questions.answer: Some courses were OK, but in general the courses had a pretty low academic level. One course had no literature..

questions.question: Were you a BA or MA student at UCPH when you were on exchange? *
Please elaborate on the level of courses *
questions.answer: I had 5 courses. 1 one pretty good - had a high level of literature and discussion. (MA-course) The other courses (3 BA courses and 1 MA course) had a low level and were bad organized. One course was only with oral presentations from the teacher and with no reading/literature/sources. Another course had a test were we had to grade each other individually  (because the teacher was lazy I guess???) One course had some really good literature, but a really confusing lecture strategy, where the teacher wrote an email when he wanted to give a lecture.. all in all very different teaching strategies.
